title: Learning How Hard to Think: Input-Adaptive Allocation of LM Computation
authors_zh: Mehul Damani、Idan Shenfeld、Andi Peng、Andreea Bobu、Jacob Andreas（机构：麻省理工学院）
paper_type_zh: 输入自适应测试时计算分配研究
best_for_zh: 构建共享推理服务、且并非每个请求都应获得相同样本数或昂贵解码路径的读者。
one_line: This work predicts each prompt’s marginal return from extra decoding and uses those predictions to allocate sampling or strong-model calls under a shared compute budget.
该工作预测每个提示从额外解码中获得的边际收益，并在共享计算预算下分配采样次数或强模型调用。
why: It gives a general optimization formulation for deciding which inputs deserve more test-time compute, rather than treating difficulty as a post-hoc statistic.
inclusion_reason: It formalizes test-time computation as a constrained allocation problem and learns to direct samples or strong decoding to prompts with the highest predicted marginal benefit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fixed test-time budgets ignore that prompts differ in both difficulty and solvability. Spending many samples on an impossible program can waste a shared serving budget, while spending only one sample on a hard-but-solvable problem can lose an answer that a few extra attempts would find. Post-hoc difficulty estimates do not solve this because obtaining them may already cost more than the decoding they are meant to allocate.

The paper asks whether the expected marginal value of another unit of decoding can be predicted from a prompt before responses are generated. Such a prediction must support a real allocation decision across a batch or a stream: it must decide whether a prompt receives another sample, a stronger model, or only a cheap default response while respecting a fixed average compute budget.

固定的测试时预算忽略了提示在难度和可解性上的差异。把许多样本花在不可能完成的程序上会浪费共享服务预算，而只给困难但可解的问题一个样本，则可能错过只需多几次尝试就能找到的答案。事后难度估计也不能解决问题，因为获得它的成本可能已经高于它本想分配的解码成本。

论文研究能否在生成回答之前，仅从提示预测再增加一个解码单位的预期边际价值。这种预测必须支持真实分配决策：它需要在遵守固定平均计算预算的同时，决定某个提示应再获得一个样本、更强模型，还是只获得廉价的默认回答。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core object is a marginal reward curve: for each prompt and each possible budget increment, estimate how much expected reward would rise if one more unit of computation were assigned. A lightweight predictor reads the base model’s hidden representation and predicts this whole vector. Allocation then chooses the highest predicted next increments across all prompts, rather than assigning the same number of samples to everyone.

This makes difficulty operational. An easy prompt may receive one inexpensive draw, an impossible prompt may receive no extra search, and a hard-but-promising prompt may receive several samples or a strong decoder. The approach applies the same idea to adaptive best-of-k reranking and to routing between weak and expensive decoding procedures, separating the allocation policy from the particular way extra compute is spent.

核心对象是一条边际奖励曲线：对每个提示和每种可能的预算增量，估计若再分配一个计算单位，预期奖励会增加多少。轻量预测器读取基础模型的隐藏表征并预测整个向量。随后，分配过程在所有提示中选择预测值最高的下一个增量，而不是给每个提示同样数量的样本。

这使难度变得可操作。简单提示可能只得到一次廉价生成，不可能的提示可能不再获得额外搜索，困难但有希望的提示则可能得到多个样本或强解码器。该方法把同一思想应用于自适应最佳候选重排序，以及弱解码与昂贵解码之间的路由，将分配策略与额外计算的具体使用方式分开。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training data are formed by estimating rewards at several budgets for each prompt and taking successive differences. A two-layer MLP on the final hidden state, or a LoRA-adapted base model, predicts the vector of marginal gains. Under diminishing returns, the constrained integer allocation has a greedy solution: repeatedly allocate the next unit to the prompt whose predicted next gain is largest. An online version optimizes known batches; an offline version learns bins whose allocations satisfy the budget in expectation.

The experiments instantiate this framework with best-of-k sampling and reranking, then with routing. Code uses StarCoder-15B and unit tests; math uses Mathstral-7B and a two-stage oracle verifier; chat routes between Gemma models or ordinary versus value-augmented sampling. The evaluation compares adaptive allocation with uniform best-of-k or always using the expensive decoder at matched average computation.

训练数据通过估计每个提示在多个预算下的奖励并取相邻差分形成。最终隐藏状态上的两层 MLP，或经 LoRA 适配的基础模型，预测边际收益向量。在收益递减假设下，受约束的整数分配有贪心解：反复把下一个单位分给预测下一步收益最大的提示。在线版本优化已知批次；离线版本学习若干分桶，使其分配在期望上满足预算。

实验以最佳候选采样和重排序实现该框架，随后用于路由。代码任务使用 StarCoder-15B 和单元测试；数学任务使用 Mathstral-7B 和两阶段预知验证器；对话任务在 Gemma 模型之间，或在普通采样与价值增强采样之间路由。评估以匹配平均计算量，将自适应分配与统一最佳候选采样或始终使用昂贵解码器比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across code, math, and chat, the learned allocation improves the stated efficiency frontier. On math, both online and offline adaptive best-of-k consistently beat uniform best-of-k across reported budgets. On code, the offline binned version consistently wins, while direct online allocation can fail at high budgets because tiny prediction errors make zero-success problems look worth searching. The paper reports that math and code can match non-adaptive quality with up to 50% less compute.

Routing provides a second test of the same decision rule. For model routing and value-augmented sampling, the system matches the expensive decoder while calling it only 50–75% as often; value augmentation reports a 25–40% reduction in expensive calls at comparable reward. Predictor analyses show 72–84% above/below-median marginal-reward classification accuracy, but the error analysis makes clear that calibration, not just ranking, matters when allocation becomes aggressive.

在代码、数学和对话任务上，学习到的分配改善了论文所述的效率前沿。在数学上，在线和离线自适应最佳候选采样都在报告的各预算下持续超过统一最佳候选采样。在代码上，离线分桶版本持续获胜，而直接在线分配在高预算时可能失败，因为微小预测误差会让成功率为零的问题看起来值得搜索。论文报告数学和代码可用最多 50% 更少的计算匹配非自适应质量。

路由为同一决策规则提供第二种检验。无论模型路由还是价值增强采样，系统都能以只调用昂贵解码器 50–75% 次数的方式匹配它；价值增强报告在可比奖励下昂贵调用减少 25–40%。预测器分析显示，边际奖励高低于中位数的分类准确率为 72–84%，但误差分析也说明，当分配变得激进时，校准而不只是排序同样重要。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This paper makes “how hard should a model think?” a prediction-and-optimization problem rather than a heuristic threshold. Its predictor targets marginal benefit, not only prompt difficulty or answer confidence, so it can distinguish a difficult query that extra compute can help from one that is unlikely to improve. The allocation rule explicitly couples all requests through a shared resource constraint.

The framework is also intentionally decoder-agnostic. The same learned quantity decides sample counts in search and whether to invoke a stronger procedure in routing. This establishes a reusable bridge between hidden-state probing, reward estimation, and serving-level resource scheduling, and it exposes a practical distinction between online batch-optimal allocation and independently deployable but distribution-sensitive offline policies.

论文把“模型应思考多难”变成预测与优化问题，而不是启发式阈值。其预测器针对边际收益，而不仅是提示难度或答案置信度，因此能区分额外计算有帮助的困难问题和不太可能改善的问题。分配规则通过共享资源约束，明确耦合所有请求。

该框架还刻意不依赖具体解码器。同一个学习量既决定搜索中的样本数，也决定路由中是否调用更强程序。它在隐藏状态探测、奖励估计和服务级资源调度之间建立可复用桥梁，并揭示在线批次最优分配与可独立部署但对分布敏感的离线策略之间的实际区别。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach needs reward data at multiple budgets to train its predictor, and it inherits any error or bias in the verifier. Online allocation requires a batch of known requests, while offline bins can violate the intended budget after distribution shift. The code result shows that small probability errors can lead to severe misallocation among impossible problems, so the policy is not safely transferable without calibration and guardrails.
该方法需要多个预算下的奖励数据来训练预测器，并会继承验证器的任何错误或偏差。在线分配需要一批已知请求，而离线分桶在分布偏移后可能违反目标预算。代码结果表明，微小的成功概率误差会让不可能问题获得严重错误分配，因此未经校准和保护措施，策略并不能安全迁移。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper as the conceptual starting point for a scheduler that shares test-time capacity across many requests. Measure a per-input gain curve, validate calibration separately from ranking, and compare the online optimization with a conservative offline policy under workload shift. It is most applicable when quality can be evaluated at least during development; it does not remove the need for a trustworthy reward or verifier.
可将这篇论文作为在许多请求之间共享测试时能力的调度器概念起点。应测量输入级收益曲线，单独验证校准而非只验证排序，并在工作负载偏移下比较在线优化与保守的离线策略。它最适用于至少能在开发阶段评估质量的场景；它并未消除对可信奖励或验证器的需求。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the code failure analysis before adopting the greedy allocator as a generic production rule. The lasting contribution is the marginal-reward target and the shared-budget formulation, not a claim that any hidden-state difficulty probe is calibrated enough. A useful replication should include impossible instances, out-of-distribution traffic, and a fallback budget so a false positive cannot absorb the entire batch allocation.
在把贪心分配器当作通用生产规则之前，应先阅读代码任务失败分析。持久贡献是边际奖励目标和共享预算表述，而不是声称任何隐藏状态难度探测都足够校准。一个有价值的复现应包含不可能样例、分布外流量和回退预算，防止一次假阳性吞掉整个批次的分配。
